observations.detail: Video starts with Superman punching Joker through the chest, captions sync cleanly with narration.
Narration flows smoothly as Superman hallucinates Lois as Doomsday.
Metropolis destruction scene rendered clearly with appropriate visual framing.
Batman rushes into the interrogation room while Superman confronts Joker.
Superman demanding an end to hostilities, captions display word by word in yellow.
Final scenes showing the new world order and lethal force maintain high production quality.
